name: Llima
source:
Interest: Nature & Lima Beans

The polar opposite of [url=https://vndb.org/c56750]Flori[/url], Llima appears to be strong on the outside. In actuality, she is more fragile than she lets on. Her desire to be loved clashes with her low self-esteem, ironically failing to realize how much she means to Flori.
